verdict.rationale: llamafile runs a local HTTP server with an API, so the question of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials fairly applies. However, the evidence pack never documents API keys, tokens, or any credential scoping. The server sandbox and the no-outbound-network restriction ([llamafile-docs-9], [llamafile-docs-10]) are adjacent security controls, not credential issuance, so they earn no credit.
